table.name: TLGNS_SAP_CONTRACT_ITEM
table.description: Contains the item-level attributes of a Contract as received from SAP via the Contracts/STPO interface. Only fields relevant for LOGON are imported into this table; additional fields can be added when required by additional functional specification.

column.name: SAP_CONTRACT_ITEM_ID
column.description: PK. Technical ID given by LOGON DB when object is created, based on a sequence.

column.name: SAP_CONTRACT_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_contract. The contract (Logon identifier!) to which this items belongs.

column.name: CONTRACT_ITEM_NO
column.description: Contract item number in SAP. (Origin: VBAP.POSNR / E1EDP01.posex). Special values: -2: planning landfill, -3: planning aggregate.

column.name: SAP_MATERIAL_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_material. The material of this contract item. (Origin: VBAP.MATNR / E1EDP19.IDTNR.qualf.002, mapped via tlgns_sap_material.sap_material_no)

column.name: PRODUCTION_PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_bs. FK tlgnr_plant_bs. Not used. Prroduction plant is now a material property. (Origin before 2.0.0.9: VBAP.CHARG / ZE1DP19.IDTNR.qualf.010, Batch number!) The usage had been removed on behalf of LRQ 011.1.

column.name: SUPPLY_PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_bs. Supply plant to be used for orders based on this contract. If not set: Supply plant to be set in LOGON, in Dispokarte/Order Taking. Note that a LOGON order has the supply plant at order level (not item!), i.e. all items of the order will have the same supply plant (set from the first selected contract item which restricts it). (Origin: VBAP.WERKS / E1EDP01.werks)

column.name: MATERIAL_GROUP_1
column.description: Type of Bag. LOGON usage for now: Just store. (Origin: VBAP.MVGR1 / E1EDP35.cusadd.qualz.017)

column.name: MATERIAL_GROUP_2
column.description: Packaging Type (1=Bulk, 2=Bag. But for AFR apparently also PAL=Pallets, BBG=Big Bags, DRM=Drums, …). LOGON usage for now: Just store. LOGON will use the packagin type from the material itself, not from the one contained in contract item! (Origin: VBAP.MVGR2 / E1EDP35.cusadd.qualz.018)

column.name: MATERIAL_GROUP_3
column.description: Grouping (RMX, CEM or AGG). LOGON usage for now: Just store. (Origin: VBAP.MVGR3 / E1EDP35.cusadd.qualz.019)

column.name: MATERIAL_GROUP_4
column.description: AFR Type of Product (EW=End-of-waste, BP=By-product, …). LOGON usage for now: Just store. (Origin: VBAP.MVGR4 / E1EDP35.cusadd.qualz.020)

column.name: MATERIAL_GROUP_5
column.description: Type of Bag. LOGON usage for now: Just store. (Origin: VBAP.MVGR5 / E1EDP35.cusadd.qualz.021)

column.name: ITEM_CATEGORY
column.description: Item Category. LOGON usage for now: Just store (Origin: VBAP.PSTYV)

column.name: TARGET_QUANTITY
column.description: Target quantity expressed in sales units (target_quantity_uom_cd). (Origin: VBAP.ZMENG / ZE1EDP.ZPTENTR). For an Advance Payment contract, this value is a cumulative sum over all of its members which is updated in the sapimport_sdn_pkg script.

column.name: TARGET_QUANTITY_UOM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_bs. Unit of measure in which target_quantity is expressed. Mandatory, if target_quantity is set. (Origin: VBAP.MEINS / ZE1EDP1.ZBMEINS)

column.name: NET_VALUE
column.description: Item Net Value of the item target quantity expressed in currency of the contract (tlgns_sap_contract.currency_cd). (Origin: VBAP.NETWR / E1EDP01.NETWR)

column.name: VAT_PERCENTAGE
column.description: Vat of the contract item in percentage. Example (Switzerland 8.0% Vat): ZPVAT = “8.0”

column.name: MARKED_FOR_DELETION
column.description: Deletion code in SAP (Sales Document Notification -> Document Item General Data field ABGRU (for contract) and field ZLOEKZ (for STPO)). 1=deleted, else active. Note that Logon normally has active_flag, with inversed logic. We stick to SAP standards in the tlgns_sap_... tables.

column.name: TRANSPORT_COST_INCLUDED_FLAG
column.description: Defines whether or not the transport costs are already included in the net value of the item.

column.name: IS_AP_GROUP_LEADER
column.description: Defines whether this contract item represents an Advance Payment Group Leader - a virtual contract item from which other contract items are associated to for easier lookup and group associations

column.name: AP_GROUP_LEADER_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_contract_item: For a Group Leader (IS_AP_GROUP_LEADER = TRUE) this value is NULL, for non-group-leaders is references the SAP_CONTRACT_ITEM_ID of the item representing the AP Group Leader.

column.name: TOTAL_SENT_QUANTITY
column.description: Total quantity sent to SAP expressed in sales units (target_quantity_uom_cd). This value is only updated once an order has been marked as FINISHED. For an Advance Payment group leader, this represents the entire quantity over all of its members. TARGET_QUANTITY - TOTAL_SENT_QUANTITY will always give the amount of quantity still open or remaining.

column.name: ADVANCE_INVOICE_NO
column.description: Advance Invoice Number received from the weighing system. Used in the delivery note printing for export invoice (Serbia).

column.name: PARENT_OFFER_NO
column.description: Parent offer number. LOGON will retrieve this value in field TDLINE in the segment for TDID
